verdict: Leads up 50% this week; Google Ads spend efficiency needs correction.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 26 leads at an average cost of $156.94 per lead, with all 26 coming through Meta at $59.76 per lead. Google Ads consumed $2,526.66 of your budget and returned only 2 conversions — a stark gap versus Meta's performance that we are actively addressing through bid and targeting adjustments on the Search campaign. The most encouraging signal this week is a 50% jump in leads paired with a 21% drop in cost per lead, driven by Meta's improving delivery. Next period, expect continued pressure on Google efficiency as those changes take hold, and a cleaner read on whether the recent lead pace holds.
